sources.title: CiNii Books NCID BA59231697：1976偉文《萬暦野獲編》五冊本、史語所館藏影印底本機構
sources.provider: Japan National Institute of Informatics (CiNii Books), public union catalog
sources.historical_period: Modern Taiwan 1976-09 printed facsimile; underlying manuscript date not authenticated by the catalog
sources.quality_notes: CiNii NCID BA59231697 lists 5-volume 1976 Taipei Weiwen print and explicit note facsimile from Academia Sinica IHP holding; 15 Japanese library collections include item-level Tokyo and Kyoto 5-volume records. NDL mirror of identical NCID is no extra old-manuscript vote. Not physical barcode174009 identification, target folio reading, original 1827/1869 imprint or binding of NCL02260.

sources.quality_notes: General policy distinguishes free domestic online database access, restricted foreign access, and levels of image resolution/authorization.
